After this card the copy lives in the target package (Wanted 1–2), so that link lands nowhere.

Asked of this card, in the same PR: the clone response names the package the copy landed in, and that one link reads it. The link opens the copy in Studio's automations surface of that package, in the shape the dev settles. A release cut right after this card must not ship a dead link. N-22 (#28567, Studio "New similar") only checks the link and re-points it only if this PR did not. This is a rider on the card's own scope (its console surface), not a new card; it is one `ui/` line declared beside the card's `domain:server` lane.
